title: What are you doing tomorrow?
summary: Present continuous для **договорённостей и планов** на будущее (**I'm meeting Tom tomorrow**) и present simple для расписаний.
ru:
## Present continuous о будущем
Мы уже знаем **am / is / are + -ing** для действия «прямо сейчас». Но то же время используется и для **ближайшего будущего**, если мы **заранее договорились или спланировали**.
> They **are playing** tennis now. — Они сейчас играют в теннис. (сейчас)
> Andrew **is playing** tennis tomorrow. — Эндрю завтра играет в теннис. (договорились)
> I'm **not working** next week. — Я не работаю на следующей неделе.

По-русски мы тоже можем сказать «Завтра я иду к врачу» — настоящее время в значении будущего. Это и есть present continuous.

## Когда использовать
**I'm doing something tomorrow** = у меня уже есть план, договорённость, билет, встреча.
> Alice **is going** to the dentist on Friday. — Элис в пятницу идёт к зубному (записана).
> We're **having** a party next weekend. — В выходные у нас вечеринка.
> Are you **meeting** Bill this evening? — Ты встречаешься с Биллом вечером?
> What are you **doing** tomorrow evening? — Что ты делаешь завтра вечером?
> I'm **not going** out tonight. I'm **staying** at home. — Сегодня вечером я не выхожу, остаюсь дома.

## Не present simple!
Для планов и договорённостей present simple **не** используем.
- ~~I stay at home this evening.~~ → I'm **staying** at home this evening.
- ~~Do you go out tonight?~~ → **Are** you **going** out tonight?
- ~~Ann doesn't come to the party.~~ → Ann **isn't coming** to the party.

## Present simple для расписаний
Для **расписаний, программ, поездов, автобусов, фильмов** используем present simple.
> The train **arrives** at 7.30. — Поезд прибывает в 7.30.
> What time **does** the film **finish**? — Во сколько заканчивается фильм?

## Сравнение
| present continuous (люди) | present simple (расписание) |
|---|---|
| I'm going to a concert tomorrow. | The concert starts at 7.30. |
| What time are you leaving? | What time does your train leave? |

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~I go to the cinema tomorrow.~~ → I'm **going** to the cinema tomorrow.
- ~~We meet them at 5. (договорились)~~ → We're **meeting** them at 5.
en:
## The present continuous for the future
We know **am / is / are + -ing** for things happening now. We also use it for the **future** when we have **arranged** or **planned** something.
> They **are playing** tennis now. (now)
> Andrew **is playing** tennis tomorrow. (arranged)
> I'm **not working** next week.

## When to use it
**I'm doing something tomorrow** = I have a plan or an arrangement (an appointment, a ticket, a meeting).
> Alice **is going** to the dentist on Friday.
> We're **having** a party next weekend.
> Are you **meeting** Bill this evening?
> What are you **doing** tomorrow evening?
> I'm **not going** out tonight. I'm **staying** at home.

## Not the present simple!
Don't use the present simple for plans and arrangements.
- ~~I stay at home this evening.~~ → I'm **staying** at home this evening.
- ~~Do you go out tonight?~~ → **Are** you **going** out tonight?
- ~~Ann doesn't come to the party.~~ → Ann **isn't coming** to the party.

## The present simple for timetables
We use the present simple for **timetables, programmes, trains, buses and films**.
> The train **arrives** at 7.30.
> What time **does** the film **finish**?

## Compare
| present continuous (people) | present simple (timetable) |
|---|---|
| I'm going to a concert tomorrow. | The concert starts at 7.30. |
| What time are you leaving? | What time does your train leave? |

## Common mistakes
- ~~I go to the cinema tomorrow.~~ → I'm **going** to the cinema tomorrow.
structure:
## Формы (будущее: договорённость)
| Утверждение | Отрицание | Вопрос |
|---|---|---|
| I'm meeting Tom at 6. | I'm not meeting Tom. | Am I meeting Tom? |
| She's going to the dentist. | She isn't going to the dentist. | Is she going to the dentist? |
| We're having a party. | We aren't having a party. | Are we having a party? |

## Слова-подсказки
- tomorrow, tonight, this evening, next week, next Friday, on Saturday, at the weekend

## Полезные вопросы
- **What are you doing** tomorrow / tonight / at the weekend?
- **Are you doing** anything this evening?
- **What time are you meeting** her?

## Формула
> **am / is / are + -ing** + время в будущем — договорённость, план
> **present simple** + время — расписание (поезд, фильм, урок)

## Краткие ответы
- Are you going out tonight? — Yes, I **am**. / No, I'm **not**.
- Is she coming? — Yes, she **is**. / No, she **isn't**.
